forum.title: Bugged FSM in MEMS studio
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Bennny ,

SRP is updated at runtime therefore the only way to see reset pointer updating is performing FSM debug using a log.

We identified an issue in FSM configuration, we will fix it in next release. We will provide visibility of fixed data parameters in next version.
forum.content_text:
Hello.

I'm working on project with LSM6DSO and I use FSM.

For easier programming I use the FSM Feature in MEMS studio, but it looks like it's buggy:

1 - SRP doesn't change the graphical diagram of FSM. It always point to start of the program on RNC.

Example: ![image.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/403e810c-d940-d76f-da42-632d45af39ad.png "image.png")

2 - Adding STIMER3/4 lead to error when I try to export the register config (save device configuration as):

![image.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/bcf714ec-01df-f740-da90-53e6b6b269d0.png "image.png")

![image.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8b2dcff3-73fd-3649-56f8-bc8b24de1959.png "image.png")

There are also missing settings from the Fixed Data section (CONFIG\_A, CONFIG\_B, SETTINGS) which could be important.

Thanks
forum.author: Bennny

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @Bennny ,

SRP is updated at runtime therefore the only way to see reset pointer updating is performing FSM debug using a log.

We identified an issue in FSM configuration, we will fix it in next release. We will provide visibility of fixed data parameters in next version.
